LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDown.label: Ranged cooldown reduction
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDown.description: Reduces the cooldown of ranged weapons. This stat is used for the RatHolic gun's spin-up effect.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDownMultiplier.label: Ranged cooldown multiplier
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDownMultiplier.descript: Applies a multiplier to ranged weapon cooldowns. This stat is used together with stat factors for the RatHolic gun's spin-up effect.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldBlockChance.label: Shield block chance
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldBlockChance.description:
The chance to attempt a block with a shield.

If the shield block succeeds, the game then determines whether the attack penetrates the shield.

Affected by Melee skill, Manipulation, and Sight.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_DeflectAngle.label: Shield block angle
LanguageData.RK_Stat_DeflectAngle.description: The forward cone angle within which this shield can block incoming attacks. For example, 90° means 45° to either side.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStuffBase.label: Shield armor - material factor
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Sharp.label: Shield armor - sharp
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Sharp.description:
This shield's armor against sharp damage, such as bullets, cuts, explosions, and animal bites.

When attacked, armor is reduced by the attacking weapon's armor penetration.

For this shield only, the remaining armor is compared against a single random roll.

 - If the random value is lower than the remaining armor, the attack is negated.
 - Otherwise, the block has no effect.

For example, against an attack with 90% armor and 10% penetration, the remaining armor is 80%, so the attack has about an 80% chance to be blocked.
